items.markdown:
Project management is `the practice of planning, organizing, and executing tasks to turn an idea into a final deliverable within specific limits like time, budget, and scope`.[[1]](https://www.pmi.org/about/what-is-project-management)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Project_management)

### Core Phases

- **Initiation:** Define the project goals, scope, and key sponsors.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OyrKGopOGpQ&t=4)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0xtamOD7FLU&t=16)
- **Planning:** Build a roadmap detailing tasks, timelines, budgets, and risk strategies.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ThDdHETxA-g&t=81)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OyrKGopOGpQ&t=4)
- **Execution:** Turn the plan into action while leading the team and managing resources.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0xtamOD7FLU&t=16)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OyrKGopOGpQ&t=4)
- **Monitoring:** Track progress, measure performance, and fix issues or risks.[[1]](https://www.atlassian.com/work-management/project-management)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OyrKGopOGpQ&t=4)
- **Closure:** Deliver the final result, review performance, and archive records.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OyrKGopOGpQ&t=4)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0xtamOD7FLU&t=16)

### Main Methodologies

- **Waterfall:** A traditional, linear approach where each phase must finish before the next one starts.[[1]](https://www.forbes.com/advisor/business/what-is-project-management/)[[2]](https://www.atlassian.com/work-management/project-management)
- **Agile:** A flexible, iterative approach that breaks work into short cycles or sprints.[[1]](https://www.forbes.com/advisor/business/what-is-project-management/)[[2]](https://www.atlassian.com/work-management/project-management)
- **Hybrid:** A blend of both traditional planning and flexible execution.[[1]](https://www.forbes.com/advisor/business/what-is-project-management/)[[2]](https://www.atlassian.com/work-management/project-management)

### Popular Tools & Certifications

- **Software:** Digital platforms like [Asana](https://asana.com/), [Trello](https://trello.com/) , and [Monday.com](https://monday.com/) help teams track tasks and timelines.[[1]](https://www.4pmti.com/what-is-project-management/)[[2]](https://www.forbes.com/advisor/business/what-is-project-management/)
- **Credentials:** Leading bodies like the [Project Management Institute](https://www.pmi.org/) offer gold-standard credentials like the Project Management Professional (PMP) to boost career growth.[[1]](https://www.pmi.org/)[[2]](https://www.forbes.com/advisor/business/what-is-project-management/)[[3]](https://www.4pmti.com/what-is-project-management/)
